title: Red Rooster | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Home is Across street from 12,000-square-foot Community Pool!* 5 Min Walk to the Beach!* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool* 4 Fun Pug Bikes Included* 7 Private Decks and Balconies* New gas grill
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Home is Across street from 12,000-square-foot Community Pool!* 5 Min Walk to the Beach!* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool* 4 Fun Pug Bikes Included* 7 Private Decks and Balconies* New gas grill and Green Egg smoker* Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* Family-Friendly Extras – Highchair and Pack ’n Play provided for little ones.* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Wake up to the laid-back luxury of 30A at Red Rooster, a stunning tri-level beach home designed for unforgettable coastal getaways. Spend slow mornings on one of 7 private decks and balconies, gather around the spacious kitchen and dining area, then head to the beach or the community’s incredible lagoon-style pool.With 3 king suites, a fun bunk room, and plenty of indoor and outdoor space, everyone can spread out and relax. After a day in the sun, rinse off in the outdoor shower, fire up the gas grill or Green Egg smoker, and unwind as the evening breeze rolls through. With private beach access, resort-style amenities, and a prime 30A location, Red Rooster is more than a place to stay—it’s your home base for the ultimate beach vacation.Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom 1- King BedLiving Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds*Parking passes will be provided equal to the number of bedrooms in the home. Not all parking spots are located directly by the home. Additional passes may be purchased for $50 each. Wristbands are required for use of the Seacrest Beach amenities and are limited to the maximum occupancy of the home. *Seacrest Beach Community is perfectly nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach on Hwy 30A. This luxury development offers an array of amenities including deeded beach access just across the street, a huge 12,000 square-foot community lagoon pool, an amphitheater, seasonal tram service to the beach or pool, and 1.35 miles of walking trails! The convenient location is within walking distance to world-class dining, spas, wine bars, and many wonderful locally owned shops! Area Attractions:At Rosemary Beach, you can find an Old World-style town center with restaurants, coffee shops, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. At Alys Beach, you will find a palm-lined entry with beautiful architecture and unique dining options.At Inlet Beach, you will find 30Avenue for additional dining and shopping experiences. 30Avenue is located just north of Rosemary Beach across Hwy 98, very close to The Donut Hole and Shades Sports Bar. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
